latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Effects Generator.

- Add visual effects to video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB) and export as 1080p MP4.
- Fast, cloud GPU-powered video processing (30–60 seconds per clip) with no local install required.
- Automatic session, token, and credit management (100 free credits, 7-day tokens).
- Simple chat-driven editing (add effects, export video, check credits/balance).
- Robust workflow support: upload, edit, preview, and export videos for TikTok and similar platforms.
